fact: When reconciliation repeats an unresolved set of proposals, the Lead must refer the disagreement to the user.
A Designer entering Consult saves the interrupted assignment; an accepted answer accompanies the resumed assignment.
Design records the user's answer and resumes the interrupted round for an escalation or returns to synthesis after a signoff question or repeated disagreement.
Member designers refer questions outside their responsibility to the lead, who owns design and review sign-off.
